description: For the queries a buyer actually types, which pages currently answer them, and is this site one of them? Every other tool here reads the site's own bytes; this reads the market around it, which is the gap a clean site can still have. PASS `queries` with real buyer phrases ("AI demo video generator", "transactional email API") - you are holding the page and are far better placed to name the market than a category enum, and the category fallback is deliberately weak. Returns the retrieved pages per query so every claim can be opened and checked. It does NOT name rival brands and it does NOT report what ChatGPT says: this is web retrieval, a sound proxy for citation but not a reading of any model's answer. Never restate it as one. Admin token required; it bills per search.

category.description: Only used to build fallback queries when `queries` is omitted.

queries.description: Up to 4 buyer queries. Strongly preferred over the category fallback.

name: answer_engine_gap
